scenarios.name: Verified allow
scenarios.description: Current authoritative cryptographic credential establishes permission in active frame.

scenarios.name: Verified deny
scenarios.description: Authoritative registry confirms explicit revocation / denial.

scenarios.name: API timeout
scenarios.description: Remote authority fails to respond within SLA.

scenarios.name: Conflicting authoritative sources
scenarios.description: Two co-equal trusted authorities return conflicting grant and revoke records.

scenarios.name: Stale authorization
scenarios.description: Valid authorization token presented after world state mutation / context epoch bump.

scenarios.name: Partial tool success
scenarios.description: External write request queued successfully but state change receipt not yet received.

scenarios.name: Dangerous fallback
scenarios.description: Target is unresolved and system is requested to proceed with explicit fallback default=False.

scenarios.name: Contradictory context
scenarios.description: Mutually unsatisfiable hard premises admit zero admissible worlds (W_factive = empty).

scenarios.name: Correlated compound invariant
scenarios.description: Individual propositions P and Q are unresolved, but joint relation enforces P XOR Q == True in all admissible worlds.

scenarios.name: Accidental coercion
scenarios.description: Indeterminate epistemic object passed into host-language boolean condition / serializer.

scenarios.name: Authority replay
scenarios.description: Resolution capability replayed across mutated WorldStateID.

scenarios.name: Missing vs conflicting evidence
scenarios.description: Compare unresolved state from zero evidence vs unresolved state from conflicting evidence.
